svg.title: SenseSearch, HR-MMsearch Benchmark, and Overall Performance
svg.desc: Editable reconstruction of a three-panel infographic. Base frames include the left SenseSearch workflow, upper-right HR-MMsearch benchmark, and lower-right bar chart. Left workflow contains chat bubbles, tool boxes, robot/gear/user icons, crop/search examples, photos, logo snippets, and answer text. Upper-right panel contains feature bullets and a multi-sector benchmark pie chart. Lower-right panel contains grouped bar chart with legend and values. SAM mappings are used for confirmed photos/icons only after native draft construction.

g.desc: Origin for conduction is the initial user question at upper left. Content proceeds downward through alternating robot/gear assistant icons, thought bubbles, tool boxes, search results, and the final answer. The section uses vertical equipartition with aligned left icons and aligned rounded/dashed content frames.

g.desc: Origin is the upper-left feature list; conduction moves downward through three feature bullets, then rightward to the pie chart. The pie chart is radially symmetric around its center with category labels and icons inside sectors.
Origin is the chart axes at lower-left. Bars are grouped by benchmark category, with four model bars per group and value labels above each bar. Horizontal gridlines provide proportional alignment.
